citation: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al. (2021), MEDA bundle, NASA PDS Atmospheres Node, doi:10.17189/1522849

rules.airTemperature: Calibrated ATS: median of the three mast (RSM) sensors ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1–3 (kelvin); records with fewer than two values are skipped. Body-mounted sensors 4–5 are not used.
rules.groundTemperature: Calibrated TIRS GROUND_TEMP (ground brightness temperature, kelvin). Rejected when TIRS_GROUND_FOOTPRINT_NOT_IN_SHADOW, ROVER_LOW_TILT, ROVER_STILL or WHEEL_OUTSIDE_TIRS_DOWNWARD_LOOKING_FOV is 0. A blank flag is recorded as not determined.
rules.pressure: Calibrated PS BAROCAP1_PRESSURE (pascal): the transducer in use (TRANSDUCER). Blank uncertainty = not provided.
rules.windSpeed: Derived WS HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED (meter/second), only while ROVER_STILL = 1. The product supplies a speed (not east/north components).
rules.missing: Blank CSV fields are missing values (the labels declare no special constants); they are never read as zero.
rules.timestamps: UTC interpolated from each record’s SCLK between the label’s start/stop date-time and spacecraft-clock anchors.
rules.sampling: One actual record per 10-minute slot (the nearest valid record within ±90 s); no averaging.
